1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iya Dawidi yahimbiwe kuba urwibutso.

3.text: Abashaka ubugingo bwanjye bakorwe n'isoni bamware,Abishimira ibyago byanjye basubizwe inyuma,Bagire igisuzuguriro.

4.text: Abambwira bati “Ahaa, ahaa!”Basubizwe inyuma ku bw'isoni zabo.

5.text: Abagushaka bose bakwishimire bakunezererwe,Abakunda agakiza kawe bajye bavuga bati“Imana ihimbazwe.”

6.text: Ariko jyeweho ndi umunyamubabaro n'umukene,Mana, tebuka uze aho ndi,Ni wowe mutabazi wanjye n'umukiza wanjye,Uwiteka, ntutinde.
